title: Special Problems in Physics; Particle Astrophysics
description:
Pre-requisites: PHYS313 and PHYS371 Co-Req: PHYS401 or permission of in structor

Particle Astrophysics is an emerging field using particle physics techniques to study high-energy phenomena in the Universe. In this course we will give an overview of the field with emphasis on current experiments.The topics will include cosmic rays, neutrino oscillations, neutrino astronomy, gamma-ray astronomy, gamma-ray bursts, dark matter, and dark energy. The course will be taught by scientists working on manyof the maj or experiments in the field including IceCube, HAWC, Fermi, and LIGO.
